scenario: A rule guarded by an author-written `no` over a `scope activation` schema fires once per match per LSCO.4.2: a second pump with no working-memory change does not re-fire it. Only one rule_fire_begin appears across both pumps.
rules_ds:
schema Lock scope activation:
    entity_id: String

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule gated:
    no Lock l where l.entity_id == "lock1"
    Trig
->
    log info "fired"
